answer: Sybil resistance via sponsored admission: each new agent needs a sponsor who locks a refundable bond and may admit at most two identities per epoch; the quota shrinks geometrically when a referral cheats. Like saffron, each credential is grown one stigma at a time, so mass identity demands mass collateral. A falcon-eyed auditor traces any fake to whoever paid its bond; on proven fraud the sponsor's stake is slashed and the quota collapses. An attacker spawning N sybils posts N bonds up front and forfeits the whole chain on first detection - every cheap fake leaves a costly comet-tail trail.
